title: Smallest Covering Stretch
statement:
A text `s` is made of lowercase letters, and a word `t` is given. Find the shortest block of consecutive characters of `s` that contains every letter of `t` at least as many times as `t` itself does. For example, if `t` is `aab`, the block needs at least two `a` and at least one `b`; other letters in the block are allowed.

## Input
The first line contains the text `s`. The second line contains the word `t`.

## Output
Print the length of the shortest such block. If no block works, print `-1`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |t| <= |s| <= 90000`
- `s` and `t` contain only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
